verification.method: sha256sum on both the Desktop source file and the copy placed in this repo; also full-content diff of manifest.json

manifest_snapshot.board_frame: origin top-left outer corner; +X right; +Y down; +Z toward printed face
manifest_snapshot.print: 100% actual size; disable fit-to-page; verify 100 mm scale bar

legacy_pattern_determination.why_it_matters: OpenCV >=4.7 changed the internal black/white square arrangement of CharucoBoard vs. the legacy (<=4.6) CharucoBoard_create pattern. Both the local machine (cv2 4.14.0) and cyc-server (cv2 4.13.0) only expose the new CharucoBoard class (no CharucoBoard_create), so board.setLegacyPattern(bool) must be set correctly or ChArUco corner interpolation silently maps corners to the wrong physical positions even though marker detection still 'works'.
legacy_pattern_determination.method: The source SVG embeds its ChArUco pattern as a raster <image> (not vector squares) at 4500x3600 px for the 450x360mm outer board area (10 px/mm). Extracted that embedded PNG, then rendered two candidate boards locally via camera_calibration.compat.make_charuco_board() with squares_x=10, squares_y=8, square_length_m=0.045, marker_length_m=0.032, dictionary=DICT_5X5_100, at the identical 4500x3600 px canvas / border_bits=1 / margin_size=0, once with legacy_pattern=True and once with legacy_pattern=False, then pixel-diffed each against the embedded reference image.

legacy_pattern_true.verdict: rejected - majority of pixels differ, indicating a structurally different square/marker arrangement

legacy_pattern_false.verdict: accepted - 99.67% pixel match; residual differences are small anti-aliasing blobs at marker/module edges (median 92px, max 1450px), nowhere near the ~202500px of a full 45mm square, so there is no structural mismatch

legacy_pattern_determination.conclusion: legacy_pattern: false matches the printed SVG. This was cross-checked (not assumed) against actual offline detection on cyc-server's captured frames (see calib_data/probe/a2_probe_summary.json on both this repo and cyc-server) before being adopted in configs/board_config_a2.yaml.
legacy_pattern_determination.not_guessed: This value was derived from pixel-level comparison against the authoritative SVG raster and from real-frame ChArUco corner interpolation counts, not assumed from either the 5x7 board's existing legacy_pattern=true default or from general OpenCV-version heuristics.

metric_status_note: HISTORICAL (superseded by metric_confirmation below, kept verbatim for the audit trail): square_length_mm=45.0 and marker_length_mm=32.0 are the *design* values from manifest.json. Nobody has physically measured the printed board's 100 mm scale bar or a 45 mm square with a ruler to confirm the printer reproduced it at exactly 100% scale. Treat every downstream metric pose/hand-eye result from this board as unconfirmed until a user performs and reports that physical measurement.

metric_confirmation.confirmed_by: user physical measurement (ruler/caliper against the printed A2 board)
metric_confirmation.method: User physically measured the printed A2 ChArUco board (100 mm scale bar / 45 mm squares) and reported the print scale is correct (100% actual size, not fit-to-page).
metric_confirmation.note: This confirms the *physical print scale* of the board (metric geometry is now trustworthy for pose estimation). It does NOT by itself constitute a camera calibration or a hand-eye calibration -- those are separate, still-pending steps. Historical probe artifacts under calib_data/probe/ and calib_data/cyc_probe/ were captured before this confirmation and intentionally still say metric-unconfirmed in their own summary JSON; they are left as-is (not overwritten) as a dated audit trail. Any *new* session created after this confirmation should read this field programmatically rather than re-stating a hardcoded status string.
